configuration.title: TurnStage
setting.displayLanguage: Language used in TurnStage profile editors. Auto follows VS Code. Native VS Code labels continue to follow the VS Code display language.
setting.displayLanguage.auto: Follow the VS Code display language.
setting.displayLanguage.zhTw: Use Traditional Chinese in TurnStage profile editors.
setting.displayLanguage.en: Use English in TurnStage profile editors.
setting.profileGlob: Workspace-relative glob used to discover TurnStage profiles.
setting.maxBufferedEvents: Maximum number of normalized stream events kept in memory for one session.
setting.maxConversationMessages: Maximum number of conversation messages kept in memory for one session.
setting.maxBufferedBytes: Maximum number of event bytes kept in memory for one session.
setting.streamBatchIntervalMs: Interval in milliseconds for batching stream updates sent to the editor.
setting.runRetention: Maximum number of recorded runs retained per profile.
setting.adversarialConcurrency: Maximum number of isolated Test Explorer scenarios run in parallel. Use a lower value for rate-limited targets.
setting.logLevel: Minimum detail level written to the TurnStage output channel.
setting.logLevel.info: Errors, warnings, and normal operational information.
setting.logLevel.debug: All information, including per-attempt, chunk, SSE event, timeout, retry, and mapping diagnostics. Request and event payloads are not logged.
setting.notifications.enabled: Show TurnStage notifications. Disable to keep non-modal status messages hidden.
workspaceTrust.description: Profile editing and fixture replay remain available. Network requests and privileged profile actions are disabled.
